# Mom's Design Build

> Award-winning luxury landscape design-build and interior remodeling firm serving Minneapolis and the Twin Cities west metro, Minnesota. Full-service: landscape architecture, outdoor living (pools, patios, outdoor kitchens, fireplaces), interior design and remodeling, and ongoing fine gardening.

Mom's Design Build designs and builds high-end residential outdoor and indoor spaces — swimming pools, patios, decks, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, fire features, retaining walls, landscaping — and luxury interior remodels. Based in Shakopee, MN; projects across Lake Minnetonka, Edina, Eden Prairie, Chanhassen, Prior Lake, Excelsior, Minneapolis and surrounding communities.

Contact: hello@momsdesignbuild.com · 952.277.6667 · 12275 Weckman Road, Shakopee, MN 55379
